body:
I'd rather change the documentation to match the current behavior instead, option 2 on the proposal.
This is for a few reasons, 
- The clear menu option and the clear method should do the same thing.
- Users may be relying on the current behavior and expect clear to not clear undo history.
- Clearing the text without clearing the undo history is useful, this makes it unexposed (though there are other ways to do it).
- The documentation is wrong regardless since it does not "Performs a full reset of TextEdit", which to me implies it would reset all values to default when it actually just clears the text and things like gutter line data and background color.
